about: Practice papers learners click through. They follow the layout and wording of real forms (a clinic intake form, a health plan ID card, an Explanation of Benefits, a clinic statement, and the federal Summary of Benefits and Coverage template). All names and numbers are pretend.

about.en: Show this card at the clinic and the pharmacy.
about.es: Muestras esta tarjeta en la clínica y en la farmacia.
about.zh-Hans: 在诊所和药房要出示这张卡。
about.vi: Bạn đưa thẻ này ở phòng khám và nhà thuốc.

about.en: You fill this out at your first visit to a new clinic.
about.ta: புது clinic-க்கு first time போனா இதை fill பண்ணுவீங்க.
about.es: Lo llenas en tu primera visita a una clínica nueva.
about.zh-Hans: 第一次去新诊所时要填这张表。
about.vi: Bạn điền đơn này trong lần đầu đến phòng khám mới.

about.en: Your insurance sends this after a visit. It is not a bill.
about.ta: Doctor-ஐ பார்த்த பிறகு insurance இதை அனுப்பும். இது bill இல்ல.
about.es: Tu seguro te lo manda después de una visita. No es una factura.
about.zh-Hans: 看病以后保险公司会寄给你。这不是账单。
about.vi: Bảo hiểm gửi giấy này sau buổi khám. Đây không phải hóa đơn.

lines: Member: Sam Lee     Member ID: GVH 482 1137     Group #: 7720
Patient: Sam Lee     Relationship to patient: Self
Your out-of-pocket maximum so far: $650.00 of $5,000.00
If we said no to paying for a service, you can file an appeal within 180 days.

about.en: The clinic sends this. It shows what you still need to pay.
about.ta: Clinic அனுப்பும். இன்னும் எவ்ளோ கட்டணும்னு காட்டும்.
about.es: La clínica te lo manda. Muestra lo que todavía debes pagar.
about.zh-Hans: 诊所寄来的。上面写着你还要付多少钱。
about.vi: Phòng khám gửi giấy này. Nó cho biết bạn còn phải trả bao nhiêu.

lines: Patient: Sam Lee     Date of birth: 03/15/1990
Date of service: 10/02/2026     Office visit     Charges: $180.00
Your insurance has paid its part. This balance is your copay.
Self-pay patients: ask us about a payment plan.
To pay, call Billing at 1-800-555-0199 or log in to the patient portal.

about.en: Your plan gives you this. It shows what your insurance covers and what you pay.
about.ta: உங்க plan எதுக்கு pay பண்ணும், நீங்க எவ்ளோன்னு காட்டும்.
about.es: Tu plan te lo da. Muestra qué cubre tu seguro y cuánto pagas tú.
about.zh-Hans: 保险公司给你的。上面写着保险包括什么，你要付多少。
about.vi: Chương trình bảo hiểm đưa giấy này. Nó cho biết bảo hiểm trả gì và bạn trả bao nhiêu.

lines: Summary of Benefits and Coverage: What this plan covers and what you pay
Golden Valley Health Plan     Coverage period: 01/01/2026 to 12/31/2026     Plan type: PPO
What is the overall deductible? $1,000 per person.
Are there services covered before you meet your deductible? Yes. Preventive care is covered first.
What is the out-of-pocket limit for this plan? $5,000 per person.
Will you pay less if you use a network provider? Yes. You pay more out-of-network.
Do you need a referral to see a specialist? No.
Primary care visit to treat an injury or illness: $25 copay per visit
Preventive care, screening, immunization: No charge
Some services need prior authorization before you get them.
